# Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

> > Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) — comprehensive cancer treatment, research, and patient care across New York City, New Jersey, and Long Island.

MSK is a world-leading cancer center specializing in innovative treatments including immunotherapy, CAR T cell therapy, and cancer vaccines. The institution serves patients across multiple locations in the New York metropolitan area while advancing cancer research and clinical care.
